dict.string: Vornyx Notch reads the battery levels of your connected AirPods to show them in the notch.
Vornyx Notch shows a light in the notch while a Focus is on.
Vornyx Notch finds devices running LocalSend on your network, so you can send files to them from the notch and receive files from them.
Vornyx Notch uses your location to show the local forecast on the dashboard. You can name a place in Settings instead.
